_comment: Provenance for real_diffs/. Every entry is a real, merged, public GitHub pull request,
fetched as `Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.diff` and committed verbatim.
These complement sample_diffs/ (SPEC.md §16) rather than replacing them: the samples are
hand-written to make each rule fire and are what the rules were tuned against, so they
stay as the tuned canaries. These are what the tool is actually pointed at, and they are
here to exercise the pipeline paths a 30-line hand-written diff never reaches.
`exercises` is what each diff is kept FOR — asserted in tests/test_real_diffs.py.
`deterministic_findings` is what the deterministic layer actually produces, measured,
not hoped for. Most real PRs produce zero; that is the honest number and SPEC.md §25
says why it is the expected one.

diffs.title: [Security] Bump urllib3 from 1.26.3 to 1.26.4
exercises: Tier 1 dependency_change on a real lockfile (§6)
the lockfile filter: every file excluded, zero reviewable (§7)
invariant 6 — a fully-filtered diff makes no API call at all

diffs.title: Proxy API rework
exercises: multi-batch bin-packing: ~13k estimated tokens against the 8k default (§7)
11 files in one diff, which no sample_diff reaches
a real detect-secrets hit, and a real false positive with it — see notes
notes: The two hardcoded_secrets findings are on `docs/advanced.md`, where the changed lines
are documentation examples showing `http://user:pass@proxy` URLs. detect-secrets is
right that the line contains credential-shaped text and wrong that it matters, and
the path heuristic scores it `high` because `docs/` is not `tests/`.
This is SPEC.md §21 limitation 2 caught on real input rather than argued in prose,
and it is the single most useful thing in this directory. Kept deliberately.

diffs.title: initialize `_pin` in debugger
exercises: a genuine security fix in security-relevant code (debugger PIN auth)
an ordinary multi-file Python PR with tests and a changelog
zero deterministic findings on code that is entirely about authentication

diffs.title: Prevent Response self-reference in redirect history
exercises: redirect-handling code that does NOT trip the unsafe_redirects rule (§6 Tier 2)
a false-positive check on real code, the way clean_but_suspicious.diff does on written code

diffs.title: Remove HTTP Public Key Pinning from docs
exercises: a pure-deletion diff: no added lines anywhere
the §15 exit-0 path — `No reviewable changes.`, valid JSON, no API call
